title: Criterion 8: no review over the RC-10 repairs
description: RC-10 returned VERDICT: REVISE over act 1 exact bytes. Its findings are repaired, but seven modules inside act 1 digest set changed since it ran and no reviewer has read the repairs. Charter 20 forbids offering acceptance after REVISE until every finding is fixed or owner-overruled.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh-context review over the seven changed act-1 modules and the reports describing them, raw output stored verbatim, verdict word copied exactly.

title: Produce TERM-CLOSURE-REPORT.md (charter §9/§21)
description: The final human-clarity charter names TERM-CLOSURE-REPORT.md as a required output of §9 vocabulary closure. It exists nowhere in the repo. The function is spread across policy-candidates/TERM-REGISTRY.md, round-2026-08/TERM-MIGRATION-REPORT.md and raw review RC-3, but the deliverable itself was never written and no disposition records it as satisfied elsewhere.
acceptance_criteria: A clone-visible TERM-CLOSURE-REPORT.md covering charter 9.1-9.5, naming what is unmet (P-16/P-17/P-18/P-25) rather than rounding it away.

title: Human-clarity refactor round (2026-08-05): public-clone normalization + final pre-spec gate
description: Process-housekeeping tracker for the owner-directed refactor round defined in syzygy_fable_human_clarity_refactor_round_prompt.md. Covers: preflight, P-1..P-16 dispositions, candidate extraction to tracked homes, P-6/P-7/P-8 fixes, front-door rewrite, term registry, review battery, final acceptance package. No product/implementation work.
close_reason: Round complete: front door, four-layer overview, term registry, hygiene policy, fixtures, Mission review, portable validation + docs CI, 8-vertical review battery, dispositions, and the final acceptance/readiness/clarity records. All five owner gates remain open and unperformed; the principal residual (no fresh-context review over the current bytes) is disclosed in FINAL-OWNER-ACCEPTANCE-RECORD.md §4.

title: Context fixture budget waivers name no reviewer (charter §12.4)
description: Four fixtures breach the 20000-token line: 2 (24681), 7 (21285), 8 (30048), 9 (32433). Charter 12.4 requires task decomposition or an explicit REVIEWED waiver; candidate CC-BUDGET-1 requires a waiver to name artifact, reason, scope, reviewer and expiry. Every waiver in the set records reviewer Unassigned.
acceptance_criteria: Each breaching fixture carries a waiver with a named reviewer and expiry, or is decomposed; reviewer verdicts stored verbatim.

title: AGENTS.md above the charter §7.1 word target
description: Charter 7.1 targets 900-1200 words for AGENTS.md with a hard decomposition review above 1500. It measures 1438: under the hard trigger, over the target. The Verification rules block is the grep/stale-count incident lore the charter routes to decisions/PROCESS-LESSONS.md.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md within 900-1200 words with no load-bearing rule lost - each moved rule verifiably present in PROCESS-LESSONS.md before removal.

title: Charter §7.3 default-load size not mechanically reported
description: Charter 7.3 requires reported word and token counts for README, AGENTS, the heart-and-soul skill and the default Polaris overview. CG-8 covers only README and AGENTS, in words, and no report carries all four. Charter 18 lists README/AGENTS word budgets among the checks CI must carry.
acceptance_criteria: CG-8 computes words and estimated tokens for all four default-load artifacts with denominators printed; a selftest fixture shows it able to fail.
